prompts.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: corrected SIDE modeling reference for a Blender character, square 1024x1024.
Input image 1 is the MASTER FRONT reference. Preserve this exact character identity, design, low-poly game style, body proportions, costume, materials, colors, and physical dimensions.
Input image 2 is the SIDE edit target. EDIT ONLY THIS SIDE IMAGE, returning ONE corrected side image, not a sheet.

Primary request: make the side image an accurate matching perpendicular view of the character in image 1. This is a technical turnaround correction, not a redesign. The current side has too short a robe, a higher belt and satchel, a narrower hat brim, and feet at different depths/heights. Correct these inconsistencies.

Camera must be exact orthographic SIDE profile, character facing image RIGHT, no three-quarter yaw, no camera tilt, no perspective foreshortening. The same relaxed A-pose as the front, seen from the side: the limbs project to their correct positions rather than changing the pose. Both feet planted on one common horizontal plane; front and rear feet overlap in strict side projection instead of showing an offset rear foot. The visible bag stays on this side, as in input 2.

Exact registration to MASTER FRONT on a 1024 square coordinate system (use these as proportions if output resolution differs): center of hat at x=510, top of crown y=6, crown joins brim y=98, hat brim outer horizontal diameter x=286 to732 (same width as front; circular gat), underside thickness consistent with front. Chin bottom y=304. Neck/collar and shoulder y=330-350. Waist sash top y=480 and bottom y=510. End of relaxed fingers y=668. Lowest hem of teal robe y=825, outside hem y=775, preserving the master's long flared skirt and its visible simple broad facets. Knee/pants-to-cuff transition y=880. Top of shoe/white ankle band y=918. Bottom of both soles on y=989. Brown satchel bottom y=636 and same volume/proportions as in the front. Gold sash ends y=666 and725. These heights must line up horizontally with the front image without any per-body-part vertical shifts. Full character same overall scale, same square canvas, no crop, complete hat and feet.

Keep brown angular hair, gently smooth youthful peach face, simple single dark oval eye with tiny highlight, tiny nose and smile, faceted ears, black gat and chin tie, teal flared robe, cobalt blue overlapping collar and cuffs, ivory wide sleeves, ochre belt and hanging ends, plain brown diagonal strap and satchel with one ochre clasp, charcoal faceted pants, black simple shoes with cream soles. Preserve medium low-poly surfaces with large clean planes, no added fabric weave, stitches, fine wrinkles, realistic detail, extra accessories, seams, new patterns or text. Lighting and pale neutral gray studio background match the existing front and side.
Return only the corrected clean standalone SIDE reference, without guide lines, labels, grids, measurements, borders, collages, front view, or extra views.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Input image 1 is the immutable MASTER FRONT. Input image 2 is the newly corrected SIDE edit target. Return only one final corrected SIDE image, same square canvas and EXACT same character, silhouette, low-poly style, neutral background, colors, camera and overall size as input 2.
Make only these tiny registration adjustments to the SIDE, using the FRONT as the height master. On the existing 1254x1254 side canvas: move the horizontal ochre waist belt from its current y=579..617 DOWN by 9 pixels to y=588..626; adjust the neighboring teal torso and skirt just enough to meet it cleanly. Move the brown hip satchel DOWN by 24 pixels so its bottom is y=779 (equivalent y=636 on the 1024 front); lengthen the existing diagonal strap slightly to connect, preserving the same bag size and plain flap/clasp. Extend the lowest teal skirt hem DOWN by 5 pixels to y=1010 (1024 front y=825), leaving knee and pants, cuffs and shoes fixed. Move ONLY the chin's lowest edge from y=365 down to y=372 (front y=304) using a tiny jaw/neck correction, same face and expression.
Preserve every other area, especially hat top and width, hair, shoulder, the sleeve and hand with fingertips y=818, pants knee y=1078, white ankle band y=1124, shoe soles y=1211. No global resizing or reframing. Maintain strict right-facing orthographic SIDE profile and one overlapping pair of planted feet at the same height, as input 2. Do not regenerate or reinterpret the costume. No extra detail, wrinkles, accessories, guide lines, grid, text, borders or additional views. Output a 1024x1024 image if possible; all coordinates above scale uniformly to output size.

prompts.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Input 1 is the authoritative FRONT reference, input 2 is the current SIDE correction target. Return ONLY a final SIDE image. Perform a localized correction of input 2; keep all other pixels/geometry/framing as close as possible to input 2.
Technical registration: compare the horizontal levels in FRONT image 1. The SIDE skirt in input 2 is now slightly TOO LONG: its lowest point needs to be raised by about 13 pixels on the 1254 square canvas, from y=1023 to y=1010 (front hem y=825/1024). Shorten only the bottom edge of the teal skirt, preserving the torso, waist, legs and the same overall proportions; outside/back hem at y=947 and lowest front hem at y=1010. The side brown satchel is still about 10 pixels too high; translate the entire satchel DOWN 10 pixels to bottom y=779, lengthening its strap by 10 pixels. The jaw/chin should extend 7 pixels lower to y=372, matching the front's chin y=304/1024; preserve all other facial features.
Leave the correctly aligned belt y=588..626, fingertips y=818, shoe soles y=1211 and hat top y=8 FIXED. Same hat width, face identity, orthographic right-facing camera, single overlapping planted feet, clean low-poly stylized Korean apprentice character, no design changes, no extra details, same pale neutral background. Absolutely no guide lines, text, measuring marks, grids, frames, collage, front view or additional characters. These are tiny corrections to the same existing image, not a re-render with new framing. Square full body.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit this existing image with ONE small change: move the brown hip satchel UP by 28 pixels (about 2.2% of canvas height) without changing its width or height. Its top and bottom should both move up the same distance. Shorten the diagonal strap at its bottom attachment to reconnect neatly. Preserve the satchel flap and round gold clasp exactly. Restore the plain teal robe where the bag used to cover it. Preserve EVERY OTHER part unchanged: face, hair, gat, neckline, shoulder, entire arm and hand, waist belt, hanging yellow sash, entire robe silhouette and hem, pants, shoes, camera, framing and background. Do not shift the robe or sash. This is just a small upward translation of the bag, not a redesign or global proportion change. One clean square right-facing full-body SIDE reference, no text or guides.

verification: Front unchanged; missing front link replaced with current master; side corrected and resampled for delivery; reference height and axes matched; both references packed. Existing Body mesh, UV, material assignments and transform preserved. Illustrated references retain small local differences, approximately one percent of full image height.
